name: doc-verification
description: Build document verification apps in the KC style (KC: a sibling verification harness) — rules-only schema, 7-phase pipeline from rule extraction through skill authoring and workflow distillation, per-rule packaging. Overrides schema-design (narrows to rules-only) and packaging (per-rule-skill emission); adds rule-extraction and rule-testing skills. Heavier example than slides-from-textbook; exercises multiple overrides + new skills. Inspired by KC; functional example, not production-ready.
author: kitchen-engineer42
